arxiv-1806-10413.title: Solitons in a chain of charge-parity-symmetric dimers
arxiv-1806-10413.creator: O. B. Kirikchi, Boris A. Malomed, N. Karjanto, R. Kusdiantara, H. Susanto
arxiv-1806-10413.description: Abstract (Received 28 June 2018; published 26 December 2018) We consider an array of dual-core waveguides, which represent an optical realization of a chain of dimers, with an active (gain-loss) coupling between the cores, opposite signs of discrete diffraction in the parallel arrays, and a phase-velocity mismatch between them (which is necessary for the stability of the system).

arxiv-2011-11176.title: Distance-based Data Cleaning: A Survey (Technical Report)
arxiv-2011-11176.creator: Yu Sun, Jian Zhang
arxiv-2011-11176.description: Abstract With the rapid development of the internet technology, dirty data are commonly observed in various real scenarios, e.g., owing to unreliable sensor reading, transmission and collection from heterogeneous sources. To deal with their negative effects on downstream applications, data cleaning approaches are designed to preprocess the dirty data before conducting applications.

arxiv-2104-01435.title: A Bayesian Machine Learning Algorithm for Predicting ENSO Using Short Observational Time Series
arxiv-2104-01435.creator: Nan Chen, Faheem Gilani, John Harlim
arxiv-2104-01435.description: Abstract A simple and efficient Bayesian machine learning (BML) training algorithm, which exploits only a 20-year short observational time series and an approximate prior model, is developed to predict the Niño 3 sea surface temperature (SST) index. The BML forecast significantly outperforms model-based ensemble predictions and standard machine learning forecasts.

arxiv-2204-13448.title: Spin of protons in NICA and PTR storage rings as an axion antenna
arxiv-2204-13448.creator: Nikolai N. Nikolaev
arxiv-2204-13448.description: Abstract We discuss a new approach to search for axions in the storage ring experiments, applicable at short coherence time of the in-plane polarization as is the case for protons. The technique can readily be applied at any storage ring equipped with internal polarimeter for the radial polarization of the beam (COSY, NICA, PTR).

arxiv-2205-15137.title: A Fast Gear-Shifting Actuator for Robotic Tasks with Contacts
arxiv-2205-15137.creator: Alexandre Girard, H. Harry Asada
arxiv-2205-15137.description: Abstract Vehicle power-trains use a variable transmission (multiple gear-ratios) to minimize motor size and maximize efficiency while meeting a wide-range of operating points. Robots could similarly benefit from variable transmission to save weight and improve energy efficiency; leading to potentially groundbreaking improvements for mobile and wearable robotic systems.

arxiv-2212-04485.title: A roadmap to cosmological parameter analysis with third-order shear statistics II: Analytic covariance estimate The modelling code is available at https://github.com/sheydenreich/threepoint/releases .
arxiv-2212-04485.creator: Laila Linke, Sven Heydenreich, Pierre A. Burger, Peter Schneider
arxiv-2212-04485.description: Abstract Context. Third-order weak lensing statistics are a promising tool for cosmological analyses since they extract cosmological information in the non-Gaussianity of the cosmic large-scale structure. However, such analyses require precise and accurate models for the covariance of the statistics. Aims.

arxiv-2310-06174.title: Cost-Efficient Prompt Engineering for Unsupervised Entity Resolution
arxiv-2310-06174.creator: Navapat Nananukul, Khanin Sisaengsuwanchai, Mayank Kejriwal
arxiv-2310-06174.description: Abstract Entity Resolution (ER) is the problem of semi-automatically determining when two entities refer to the same underlying entity, with applications ranging from healthcare to e-commerce. Traditional ER solutions required considerable manual expertise, including domain-specific feature engineering, as well as identification and curation of training data.

arxiv-2409-13469.title: Vibrationally coupled Rydberg atom-ion molecules
arxiv-2409-13469.creator: Ilango Maran, Liam J. Bond, Jeremy T. Young, Arghavan Safavi-Naini, Rene Gerritsma
arxiv-2409-13469.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ilango Maran, Liam J. Bond, Jeremy T. Young, Arghavan Safavi-Naini, Rene Gerritsma. We study the occurrence of Rydberg atom-ion molecules (RAIMs) in a hybrid atom-ion system with an ion crystal trapped in a Paul trap coupled to Rydberg atoms on its either ends. To assess the feasibility of such a system, we perform a detailed Floquet analysis of the effect of the Paul trap’s rf potential on the RAIMs and provide a qualitative analysis of the survival probability based on scaling laws.

arxiv-2411-10423.title: Back to Supervision: Boosting Word Boundary Detection through Frame Classification
arxiv-2411-10423.creator: Simone Carnemolla, Salvatore Calcagno, Simone Palazzo, Daniela Giordano
arxiv-2411-10423.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Simone Carnemolla, Salvatore Calcagno, Simone Palazzo, Daniela Giordano. Speech segmentation at both word and phoneme levels is crucial for various speech processing tasks. It significantly aids in extracting meaningful units from an utterance, thus enabling the generation of discrete elements. In this work we propose a model-agnostic framework to perform word boundary detection in a supervised manner also employing a labels augmentation technique and an output-frame selection strategy.

arxiv-2505-13576.title: FlexFed: Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting in Heterogeneous Federated Learning in Pervasive Computing Environments
arxiv-2505-13576.creator: Sara Alosaime, Arshad Jhumka
arxiv-2505-13576.description: Abstract Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training while preserving privacy by allowing clients (e.g., smartphones) to share model updates instead of raw data. Pervasive computing environments (e.g., for Human Activity Recognition - HAR), which we focus on in this paper, are characterised by resource-constrained end devices, streaming sensor data and intermittent user participation.

arxiv-2506-11447.title: Partitions with unique largest part and their generating functions
arxiv-2506-11447.creator: H. Kaur, M. Rana
arxiv-2506-11447.description: Abstract Abstract The paper introduce a new type of partitions where the largest part appears exactly once, and the remaining parts constitute a partition of that largest part. We derive the generating function associated with these partitions and subsequently explore several variations, providing the corresponding generating functions for each variant.

arxiv-2507-08523.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yilun Wang, Pengfei Chen ∗, Haiyu Huang, Zilong He, Gou Tan, Chuanfu Zhang, Jingkai He, Zibin Zheng. Modern software systems generate massive volumes of runtime logs, necessitating efficient and accurate log parsing to enable critical downstream tasks such as anomaly detection and root cause analysis.

arxiv-2509-19178.title: A noise-robust Monte Carlo method for electric field calculations in EMC3
arxiv-2509-19178.creator: William De Deyn, Ruben De Wolf, Vince Maes, Giovanni Samaey
arxiv-2509-19178.description: Abstract One of the main codes to analyze and optimize stellarator configurations is the EMC3 code, which implements a state-of-the-art 3D Monte Carlo plasma edge transport code. However, so far, a self-consistent treatment of the 𝑬 × 𝑩 \bm{E}\times\bm{B} drift is absent. This plasma drift is known to significantly impact the particle and heat distribution in the plasma edge.

arxiv-2602-19505.title: Test-Time Computing for Referring Multimodal Large Language Models
arxiv-2602-19505.creator: Mingrui Wu, Hao Chen, Jiayi Ji, Xiaoshuai Sun, Zhiyuan Liu, Liujuan Cao, Ming-Ming Cheng, Rongrong Ji
arxiv-2602-19505.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Mingrui Wu, Hao Chen, Jiayi Ji, Xiaoshuai Sun, Zhiyuan Liu, Liujuan Cao, Ming-Ming Cheng, Rongrong Ji. We propose ControlMLLM++ , a novel test-time adaptation framework that injects learnable visual prompts into frozen multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to enable fine-grained region-based visual reasoning without any model retraining or fine-tuning.

pmc-10559461.title: 3D-printing of the elbow in complex posttraumatic elbow-stiffness for preoperative planning, surgery-simulation and postoperative control
pmc-10559461.creator: Ronny Grunert, Dirk Winkler, Franziska Frank, Robert Moebius, Fabian Kropla, Juergen Meixensberger, Pierre Hepp, Maria Elze
pmc-10559461.description: BackgroundRestoration of mobility of the elbow after post-traumatic elbow stiffening due to osteophytes is often a problem.MethodsThe anatomical structures were segmented within the CT-scan. Afterwards, the Multi Jet Fusion 3D-printing was applied to create the model made of biocompatible and steam-sterilizable plastic.

pmc-11788150.title: TLR10 overexpression modulates immune response in A549 lung epithelial cells challenged with SARS-CoV-2 S and N proteins
pmc-11788150.creator: Špela Knez, Mojca Narat, Jernej Ogorevc
pmc-11788150.description: Toll-like receptors (TLRs) play an important role in the recognition of viral particles and activation of the innate immune system, but their role in SARS-CoV-2 infection is still poorly characterized. In the present study, we investigated the role of Toll-like receptor 10 (TLR10) in modulating the immune response during SARS-CoV-2 infection.

pmc-12448963.title: PDK1, associated with glycolytic metabolism, is a potential prognostic biomarker in osteosarcoma
pmc-12448963.creator: Jin Qi, Sihang Liu, Xufeng Hu, Xikang Luo, Yapeng Wang
pmc-12448963.description: The study explores the prognostic significance and therapeutic potential of 3-phosphoinositide dependent protein kinase-1 (PDK1) in osteosarcoma. Using bioinformatics analysis and experimental validation, we analyzed PDK1 expression and its correlation with patient prognosis from GEPIA and UCSCXena databases. High PDK1 expression was found to be significantly associated with reduced survival in osteosarcoma patients, suggesting its value as a prognostic biomarker.

pmc-12544160.title: Suppression of adipocyte ABHD6 favors anti-inflammatory and adipogenic programs to preserve adipose tissue fitness in obesity
pmc-12544160.creator: Pegah Poursharifi, Camille Attané, Isabelle Chenier, Clemence Schmitt, Roxane Lussier, Anfal Al-Mass, Yat Hei Leung, Abel Oppong, Élizabeth Dumais, Nicolas Flamand, Mohamed Abu-Farha, Jehad Abubaker, Fahd Al-Mulla, Ying Bai, Dongwei Zhang, Marie-Line Peyot, André Tchernof, SR Murthy Madiraju, Marc P
pmc-12544160.description: Some individuals exhibit metabolically healthy obesity, characterized by the expansion of white adipose tissue (WAT) without associated complications. The monoacylglycerol (MAG) hydrolase α/β-hydrolase domain-containing 6 (ABHD6) has been implicated in energy metabolism, with its global deletion conferring protection against obesity. However, the immunometabolic roles of adipocyte ABHD6 in WAT remodeling in response to nutri-stress and obesity are not known.

pmc-12607335.title: 5′,8-cyclo-dAdo and 8-oxo-dAdo DNA Lesions Are Both Substrates of Adenosine Deaminase: A Preliminary Study
pmc-12607335.creator: Bolesław T. Karwowski
pmc-12607335.description: Genetic information, whether inside or outside the nucleus, is exposed to a variety of harmful physico-chemical factors. Although DNA damage repair systems have been extensively studied, little information about post-repair and non-genomic DNA damage metabolism is available in the literature.

pmc-12737036.title: Formulation and Evaluation of Alginate Microcapsules Containing an Uncompetitive Nanomolar Dimeric Indenoindole Inhibitor of the Human Breast Cancer Resistance Pump ABCG2 with Different Excipients
pmc-12737036.creator: Krisztina Bodnár, Christelle Marminon, Florent Perret, Ádám Haimhoffer, Boglárka Papp, Pálma Fehér, Zoltán Ujhelyi, Joachim Jose, Marc Le Borgne, Ildikó Bácskay, Liza Józsa
pmc-12737036.description: Background/Objectives: The ABCG2 transporter actively effluxes anticancer drugs, reducing their efficacy and promoting multidrug resistance (MDR). Developing oral formulations of poorly soluble ABCG2 inhibitors remains challenging due to their low solubility and intestinal permeability. This study aimed to formulate and evaluate an ABCG2 inhibitor using micro- and nanoscale drug delivery systems.

pmc-12837503.title: The risk perception of disease aggravation in older patients with non-communicable diseases: a qualitative descriptive study
pmc-12837503.creator: Jizhe Wang, Xiaohong Lu, Yijun Xu, Na Na, Tong Qin, Yaqi Pan, Fan Li, Xiuli Zhu
pmc-12837503.description: BackgroundAccurate risk perception promotes patients to identify and prevent disease aggravation. The ambiguity around risk perception of disease aggravation complicates efforts for clinical workers to improve the accuracy of patients’ risk perception. This study aimed to thoroughly describe the risk perception experience of disease aggravation in older patients with non-communicable diseases.MethodsThis study employed a qualitative descriptive analysis design.

pmc-13025509.title: Clinical Observations on Postless Fiber-Reinforced Composite Restorations in Endodontically Treated Teeth with Immediate Pre-Endodontic Dentin Sealing and an Internal Adhesive Ferrule: A Case Series
pmc-13025509.creator: Alexander Bonchev
pmc-13025509.description: Background: Traditional reliance on intraradicular posts for the restoration of root-filled teeth is decreasing due to advances in adhesive dentistry. Immediate pre-endodontic dentin sealing (IPDS) aims to protect dentin during endodontic procedures and improve adhesive outcomes. For teeth with minimal remaining structure and absent ferrule, internal adhesive ferrule approaches using fiber-reinforced composites or fiber mesh offer an alternative to posts.

pmc-13110968.title: The role of chromogranin A cleavage products in onset of type 1 and 2 diabetes
pmc-13110968.creator: Gustaf Christoffersson, Elke M. Muntjewerff
pmc-13110968.description: Chromogranin A (CgA) is a pro-hormone widely expressed in neuroendocrine tissues and elevated in both type 1 (T1D) and type 2 diabetes (T2D). Its diverse biological effects arise from proteolytic cleavage into six bioactive peptides: vasostatin I and II (VS-I/II), chromofungin (CHR), pancreastatin (PST), catestatin (CST), WE-14, and serpinin—each exerting distinct and sometimes opposing functions.

pmc-13459371.title: Molecular detection and low prevalence of Human Herpesvirus 6 (HHV-6) among male blood donors in Kassala, Sudan: a preliminary single-center study
pmc-13459371.creator: Doaa M. E. Musa, Abdelrhman A. Mohammed, Yasir B. Ahmed, Duaa H. Ibrahim, Leila M. A. Abdelgader, Ghanem M. Mahjaf, Alhaj S. M. A. Ali, Babbiker Mohammed Taher Gorish, Nadir Abuzeid
pmc-13459371.description: ObjectiveHuman herpesvirus 6 (HHV-6) is a latent beta-herpesvirus with potential transfusion-transmissible relevance, particularly in immunocompromised recipients. Data on HHV-6 viremia among Sudanese blood donors are extremely limited. This study aimed to determine the molecular prevalence of HHV-6 DNA among blood donors in Kassala, Sudan. A descriptive cross-sectional study was conducted at Kassala Teaching Hospital.

pmc-13536429.title: Comparison of the performances of different updated generative artificial intelligence models on the Japanese National Dental Examination
pmc-13536429.creator: Shuma Hamaguchi, Masakazu Hamada, Shunya Ikeda, Satoru Kusaka, Tatsuya Akitomo, Ryota Nomura
pmc-13536429.description: Background/purposeArtificial intelligence (AI) has become widely used and applied in various fields. Although several studies have been conducted using generative AI for various qualification exams, to the best of our knowledge, none has focused on performance changes over time.Materials and methodsIn August 2025, ChatGPT 5, Gemini 2.

pmc-13551848.title: Genome-wide characterization of the bZIP gene family in Rattus norvegicus and expression profiling analysis during brain development
pmc-13551848.creator: Pan Lu, Zongjun Zhu, Yuanyuan Guan, Ya Wang, Ruiquan Chen, Hongbo Xiao
pmc-13551848.description: BackgroundThe brown rat (Rattus norvegicus) serves as a cornerstone model organism in biomedical research, particularly for understanding physiological homeostasis and stress responses. The basic leucine zipper (bZIP) transcription factor family is a pivotal regulatory network involved in growth, organogenesis, and neurodevelopment. Despite its importance, a systematic characterization of the bZIP gene family in rats has remained elusive.

pmc-13559387.title: Determinants of intensive care unit-acquired acute brain injury in acute respiratory distress syndrome: a retrospective cohort study of ventilator settings and patient factors
pmc-13559387.creator: Joonho Lee, Jinsong Park, Jeong-Am Ryu, Chi Ryang Chung, Jeong Hoon Yang, Ryoung-Eun Ko
pmc-13559387.description: BackgroundAcute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) is associated with neurological complications, but whether mechanical ventilation parameters or patient factors predominantly contribute to intensive care unit (ICU)-acquired acute brain injury (ABI) remains unclear. We aimed to determine whether ICU-acquired ABI in ARDS is independently associated with positive end-expiratory pressure (PEEP) and driving pressure delivered early after intubation or, instead, with patient-level factors.

pmc-13601857.title: Intradiscal Delivery of Notoginsenoside R1‐Loaded PLGA Nanoparticles Attenuates Intervertebral Disc Degeneration in Rats
pmc-13601857.creator: Baichuan Zheng, Haotian Zhong, Zhengwei Wang, Junyu Qin, Ziying Xie, Rong Tang, Chengshang Hu, Xiuming Zhang, Jianwen Li, Songbo Li
pmc-13601857.description: Intervertebral disc degeneration (IVDD) contributes to persistent low back pain, but existing treatments focus on symptom relief rather than addressing the degeneration. Notoginsenoside R1 (NR1), a bioactive saponin derived from Panax notoginseng, has exhibited protective effects in experimental models of disc injury. However, its clinical application is limited by poor bioavailability and rapid clearance.

pmc-13608133.title: Biomechanical Evaluation of Patient-Specific Titanium Fixation Systems for Segmental Le Fort I Osteotomy: A Finite Element Analysis
pmc-13608133.creator: Neculai Onică, Elena-Raluca Baciu, Cezara Andreea Onică, Florin-Emilian Țurcanu, Geta-Mirela Ispas, Vlad Nicolae Arsenoaia, Loredana Golovcencu, Alice Murariu
pmc-13608133.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Patient-specific Ti–6Al–4V fixation systems are increasingly used to stabilise the maxilla following segmental Le Fort I osteotomy; however, the biomechanical responses of complete locking and non-locking patient-specific fixation configurations remain insufficiently characterised. In this study, two patient-specific plate designs (a standard design and a reduced, minimally invasive design) were analysed by linear-elastic finite element analysis, each with locking and non-locking screws. Because they were developed for different indications and evaluated in distinct patient-specific anatomical models, between-model comparisons were considered descriptive.
